name: Stage 34: Brytsebo to Holmtorp
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 34, Brytsebo to Holmtorp.
utilities: Official area: Norrköpings kommun, Nyköpings kommun.

Parking is available at/near Brytsebo/Skvättan and at Fjällmossen main parking northwest of Vrångsjön; Holmtorp itself has no reliable public parking, so use Vrångsjön/Fjällmossen parking about 1.5 km before Holmtorp or arrange pickup.

Public transport is weak: Marielundsvägen is the closest researched bus stop to Brytsebo with sparse school-day line 902 service, while Holmtorp has no close stop within 2 km. Kolmården station is the nearest rail node but is far from the stage and requires bus, taxi, bike or pickup logistics.
waterSources: Official natural sources: Lilla Göljen cold spring and a second source about 1.5 km east of Lilla Göljen. Treat/filter/boil unless current signs confirm potable water; Sörmlandsleden says trail water is not routinely tested or guaranteed.
No shops, cafes, lodging, potable taps, or dependable resupply were found within 2 km of the stage; carry food and water capacity.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden/Naturkartan distance is 13 km and difficulty is medium. The corrected drawn line uses OSM relation 3690159 because the official full-network GPX shortest path was truncated to about 9 km and missed the Fjällmossen/Lilla Göljen arc; secondary current measurements include 12.5 km in the 2025 Sörmlandsleden pass and about 12.4 km in OSM geometry.

Fjällmossen reserve has confusing blue markings; follow orange Sörmlandsleden marks carefully because blue dots mark Länsstyrelsen reserve trails. The Fjällmossen loop reuses a long part of Stage 34 and should be shown as a separate local loop overlay, not merged into the through-stage line.

The route passes remote forest, hills, rocky ground, productive forestry/clear-cuts, wet sections, and long boardwalks over Fjällmossen. Lilla Göljen/Fjällmossen is the main highlight and is consistently praised by hikers, but older trip reports also mention clear-cuts, machine ruts, roots, rocks, wet ground, and slippery descents after rain.

Skvättsjön is the early official swim/rest option after about 300 m; Vrångsjön has swimming possibilities later. Lilla Göljen is beautiful but Sörmlandsleden does not recommend it as a normal bathing lake, and reserve/loop material explicitly mentions blood leeches.

No official stage-34 faults were shown on the Sörmlandsleden page as of 2026-04-27. Nearby Lövsjöstigen in Fjällmossen is temporarily closed in 2026 due to fallen trees and poor boardwalks; this is a nearby-loop warning, not a confirmed stage-34 closure.

Fjällmossen reserve rules: no tenting or caravan setup, dogs leashed, do not damage living/dead trees, pick only berries/mushrooms, and make fires only at signed/designated places where permitted while checking current fire bans and signs. The Södermanland reserve page has stricter no-fire wording, so avoid broad fire-allowed claims. Fire-ban checks on 2026-04-27 showed no ban in Norrköping or Nyköping, but this must be checked day-of.

Lilla Göljen has two shelters and is the overnight/rest node, but this is not a legal tenting area; shelters are first-come/shared and condition/capacity/firewood can change. Firewood is reported about 400 m away near the parking/road turnaround.

Access is car/bike-shuttle oriented. Naturkartan found no nearby public-transport stops for the stage; trip reports used bike shuttle logistics, and practical one-way options are two cars, bike shuttle, taxi, or pickup at Brytsebo/Vrångsjön/Holmtorp by arrangement.

facilities.name: Brytsebo stage start
facilities.description: Official start of stage 34 and junction with stage 33. Parking is noted at/near Brytsebo; nearby Skvättan/Bråvikenbranten parking also serves this side.

facilities.name: Marielundsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Closest researched bus access to Brytsebo, about 0.5 km away. Current checks point to sparse Östgötatrafiken line 902/school-day service; verify live timetable.

facilities.name: Kolmården station
facilities.description: Nearest train station but roughly 11-13 km from stage endpoints by road/route logistics; use only with bus, taxi, bike, or pickup planning.

facilities.name: Skvättsjön swim/rest
facilities.description: Official text says there is good swimming/rest about 300 m after Brytsebo. Informal lake swim/rest point, not a managed bathing-water sample site.

facilities.name: Pigans Plågosten side sight
facilities.description: Folklore boulder/short side sight mentioned by official sources and mapped in OSM. Treat as a side POI rather than a serviced rest point.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen bog boardwalks
facilities.description: Main mire/boardwalk landscape of the stage. Boardwalks make the bog crossing easier but can be slippery in rain; trip reports describe wet roots, rocks, clear-cuts and machine-rutted sections elsewhere on the stage.

facilities.name: Lilla Göljen lake
facilities.description: Scenic lake by the shelter cluster. Do not market as a normal bathing lake: Sörmlandsleden says it is not a good bathing lake, while local material mentions blood leeches.

facilities.name: Lilla Göljen shelters
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point after about 8.5 km with two shelters, covered table/rest area, grill/fireplace and strong hiker corroboration. Vindskyddskartan lists community-reported capacity around 12; first-come/shared and condition can change.

facilities.name: Lilla Göljen dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at/near the shelter area; mapped with no drinking water and no wheelchair access. No potable-water assumption at the toilet.

facilities.name: Lilla Göljen fireplace/picnic
facilities.description: Designated fire/grill place by the shelters. Use only marked fire places, do not collect reserve wood yourself, and check current fire bans/signs.

facilities.name: Lilla Göljen cold spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring near Lilla Göljen and about halfway toward the firewood store. Natural source; Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability, so treat/filter/boil.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen main parking NW Vrångsjön
facilities.description: Main reserve entrance with about 10 car spaces plus bus space, grill place, wood storage, and picnic table. Sources vary between this OSM parking geometry and the official loop-start/access coordinate near 58.686467, 16.580250; follow signed parking on site.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen main parking grill
facilities.description: Official grill place/wood storage at the main entrance. Reserve rules allow fires only at designated places where permitted; current fire bans and local signs override.

facilities.name: Second spring east of Lilla Göljen
facilities.description: Official natural source about 1.5 km from Lilla Göljen; treat/filter.

facilities.name: Vrångsjön swimming possibility
facilities.description: Official stage text says swimming is possible at Vrångsjön later in the stage. Approximate route-side shore marker; nearby Stage 35 has a separate east-shore side path/tent-on-rock note that must be checked against reserve boundaries.

facilities.name: Holmtorp stage end
facilities.description: Official end/junction with stage 35. No reliable parking directly at Holmtorp; use Vrångsjön parking about 1.5 km earlier or arrange pickup.

facilities.name: Västanåvägen bus access
facilities.description: Nearest researched Holmtorp-side bus access, roughly 2.9 km away and therefore marked as off-route planning context; verify service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules include no tenting/caravans, leashed dogs, no damaging trees/dead wood, no plant picking except berries/mushrooms, and fires only at signed/designated places where permitted. Södermanland reserve wording is stricter on fire; follow local signs and check Norrköping/Nyköping fire status day-of.

facilities.name: Nearby Lövsjöstigen closure 2026
facilities.description: Nearby reserve loop is temporarily closed in 2026 due to fallen trees and poor boardwalks. This is not a confirmed closure of Sörmlandsleden stage 34.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen burn-area tree warning
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen reports a 2024 nature-conservation burn in Fjällmossen; fire-damaged trees can fall suddenly, especially in wind. Keep to marked trails and avoid lingering under damaged trees.

facilities.name: Stage 34 corrected route geometry note
facilities.description: Stage 34 uses OSM relation 3690159 for drawing because the official full-network GPX shortest path was truncated and missed Lilla Göljen. Use official 13 km as planning distance; drawn relation measures about 12.4 km.
